rules.description: 45% discount off standard published baseline freight rates
rules.source_quote: Shipper shall receive an agreed base discount of forty-five percent (45.0%) off all published standard linehaul rates.
Residential delivery surcharges shall be waived in full and shall not be assessed on any shipment.
Where requested, liftgate service charges shall not exceed forty dollars ($40.00) per occurrence.

rules.description: Fuel surcharge fixed at 11.5% for contract term
rules.source_quote: The applicable fuel surcharge index is agreed and fixed at eleven and one-half percent (11.5%) of net linehaul freight.

rules.description: Dimensional weight divisor established at 166 cubic inches per pound
rules.source_quote: Cubic dimensional weight calculations shall strictly utilize a divisor of one hundred sixty-six (166).

rules.description: Absolute minimum linehaul charge floor of $45.00
rules.source_quote: The minimum charge floor per shipment after discount application shall be forty-five dollars ($45.00).

rules.description: Prohibition of redundant or duplicate line item billing
rules.source_quote: Carrier warrants that no individual shipment BOL or tracking number shall be invoiced more than once.

rules.description: 180 calendar days dispute submission window from invoice date
rules.source_quote: Disputes and overcharge claims must be formally submitted in writing within one hundred eighty (180) days of invoice date.
